sign_in.context: Authentication form primary action button that submits user credentials to log into the platform

component.description: AWS Amplify authentication page with email/username and password input fields. Displays login form with social sign-in options (Google, Apple) and links to forgot password and sign up flows. This button submits the form and calls AWS Cognito authentication.

sign_in.usage: Primary button label at bottom of login form. Clicked by users to authenticate and access their account dashboard.
sign_in.impact: Critical - main authentication action. All users must click this to access the platform. Failed translations could prevent login.

sign_out.context: Navigation menu option that logs user out and clears session, usually in header/sidebar dropdown

component.description: User account dropdown menu in the top navigation bar showing user avatar and name. Contains account settings, help links, and this sign out option. Clicking signs out the user via AWS Cognito, clears DataStore cache, and redirects to login page.

sign_out.usage: Menu item label in user dropdown. Clicked to end session and return to login screen.
sign_out.impact: High - secure logout action. Users rely on this to properly end sessions on shared devices.

sign_up.context: Link text or button to navigate to registration page where new users create accounts

component.description: New user registration page with form collecting email, username, password, and user type selection (instructor vs student). Includes email verification step via AWS Cognito. This text appears both as page title and on buttons/links directing to this page.

sign_up.usage: Button or link label directing users to account creation flow. Appears on login page and marketing pages.
sign_up.impact: Critical - primary user acquisition action. New users click this to create accounts and join the platform.

username.context: Form input field label for unique user identifier used during login and displayed in platform

component.description: Text field label on authentication forms. On signup, users choose a unique username. On signin, users enter their username (or email) to identify their account. Username appears throughout platform in comments, chat messages, and grade submissions.

username.usage: Input field label above text box where users type their username. Required field for account creation and login.
username.impact: High - essential identity field. Users must understand this is their unique account identifier.

password.context: Form input field label for secret credential used to authenticate user identity

component.description: Password input field (masked text) on authentication forms. On signup, users create a password meeting security requirements (length, complexity). On signin, users enter their password to authenticate. Field includes show/hide toggle icon. Password requirements displayed below field during creation.

password.usage: Input field label above password text box with bullet masking. Critical security credential.
password.impact: Critical - primary security mechanism. Users must recognize this as their secret authentication credential.

email.context: Form input field label for user's email address used for account verification and communications

component.description: Email address input field on signup, password reset, and profile settings pages. AWS Cognito sends verification emails to this address. Used for password recovery and platform notifications about assignments, grades, and announcements. Must be valid and accessible to user.

email.usage: Input field label above email text box. Validates email format on submission. Required field for account creation.
email.impact: Critical - account recovery and communication channel. Invalid email prevents password reset and important notifications.

forgot_password.context: Link text below password field on login form that triggers password reset flow via email

component.description: Small clickable link positioned below the password input field on login form. When clicked, redirects to /auth/reset page where users enter their email to receive password reset instructions from AWS Cognito. Common use case for locked-out users who cannot remember credentials.

forgot_password.usage: Clickable link text that opens password reset interface when user cannot remember their password.
forgot_password.impact: Important - helps locked-out users regain account access. Frequently used support feature.

reset_password.context: Page title and button label for password recovery flow where users create new password via email verification

component.description: Password reset page with two-step flow: (1) Enter email to receive verification code from AWS Cognito, (2) Enter verification code and new password to reset credentials. This text appears as page heading and on submit button. Includes password strength requirements display.

reset_password.usage: Page heading and primary button label for password reset submission. Users arrive here from forgot password link.
reset_password.impact: Important - account recovery action. Users who lost access rely on this to regain entry to platform.

confirm_password.context: Form input field label for password verification field that must match the password field above it

component.description: Second password input field on signup and reset password forms. Requires user to type password again to prevent typos. Real-time validation shows error if values don't match the password field. Form cannot submit until both fields match exactly.

confirm_password.usage: Input field label for password confirmation box. Validates match before form submission.
confirm_password.impact: High - prevents password entry errors. Users must understand this should match their password exactly.
